name: X-Men
blurb: The mutant saga, from the first X-Men through Logan and Deadpool.

entries.title: X-Men
entries.desc: In a world where mutants are feared and hated, Professor Charles Xavier brings together a team of gifted outcasts to fight for peace — while Magneto leads a brotherhood with darker plans for mutantkind.

entries.title: X2: X-Men United
entries.desc: A military scientist launches a genocidal attack on Xavier's school, forcing the X-Men to form an uneasy alliance with Magneto to stop a common enemy. Widely considered one of the best superhero sequels.

entries.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
entries.desc: A "cure" for mutation divides the mutant community. The X-Men must stop Magneto's war against humanity while Jean Grey returns as the unstoppable Phoenix, threatening everything.

entries.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
entries.desc: The origin story of Wolverine — from his childhood through the Weapon X program that bonded adamantium to his skeleton, and his first encounters with Sabretooth and Deadpool.

entries.title: X-Men: First Class
entries.desc: Set in the 1960s, a young Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr recruit mutants and form a bond that will eventually fracture into the X-Men vs. Brotherhood divide. A stylish Cold War origin story.

entries.title: The Wolverine
entries.desc: Logan travels to Japan, where he confronts his immortality, falls in love, and battles the Silver Samurai in a samurai-noir story that strips Wolverine down to his essence.

entries.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
entries.prereq: X-Men: First Class, X-Men: The Last Stand
entries.desc: Wolverine is sent back to 1973 to prevent an apocalyptic future where Sentinels hunt mutants to extinction — uniting the original and First Class casts in a time-bending epic.

entries.title: Deadpool
entries.desc: Wade Wilson, a former Special Forces operative turned mercenary, undergoes a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing and a twisted sense of humor — and a thirst for revenge.

entries.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
entries.desc: The world's first and most powerful mutant, Apocalypse, awakens after thousands of years and recruits Magneto and others as his Four Horsemen to cleanse the Earth.

entries.title: Logan
entries.desc: In a near future, an aging Logan cares for a deteriorating Professor X while protecting a young mutant girl with powers eerily similar to his own. A brutal, emotional farewell to Hugh Jackman's Wolverine.

entries.title: Deadpool 2
entries.desc: Deadpool forms the X-Force to protect a young mutant from Cable, a cybernetic soldier from the future — with more fourth-wall breaks, mayhem, and surprisingly heartfelt moments.

entries.title: Dark Phoenix
entries.desc: Jean Grey is possessed by the cosmic Phoenix Force during a space mission and struggles with its immense power — pitting the X-Men against one of their own in an emotional finale.

entries.title: The New Mutants
entries.desc: Five young mutants held in a secret facility discover their powers while confronting their past traumas — a horror-tinged coming-of-age story set in the X-Men universe.

entries.title: Legion S1
entries.desc: David Haller, diagnosed with schizophrenia, discovers the voices in his head may be manifestations of his mutant abilities. A visually stunning, mind-bending psychological thriller. 8 episodes.

entries.title: Legion S2
entries.desc: David returns from the astral plane to find the Shadow King has new allies. Reality warps further as David's power and instability grow. 11 episodes.

entries.title: Legion S3
entries.desc: The final season sees David and the Shadow King travel through time, culminating in a reality-altering confrontation. 8 episodes.

entries.title: The Gifted S1
entries.desc: A suburban couple discovers their children are mutants and goes on the run, joining an underground network of mutant refugees fighting a government agency. 13 episodes.

entries.title: The Gifted S2
entries.desc: The Mutant Underground splinters between idealism and extremism as the Hellfire Club rises. 16 episodes.

entries.title: X-Men '97 S1
entries.desc: A direct continuation of the beloved 90s X-Men animated series. Cyclops, Wolverine, Storm, Rogue, Gambit, Beast, Jubilee and Morph face a world without Professor X — and a dangerous new threat. 10 episodes.

entries.title: X-Men '97 S2
entries.desc: Season 2 picks up after the explosive finale, with the team scattered across time and facing an even greater existential threat to mutantkind. Apocalypse rises. 10 episodes.
